However, the query is penalized by much higher TPSA, increasing from 52.9 to 92.5 Å² (+39.6), which is a substantial setback because BBB-active molecules usually do better with lower polar surface area. The neutral fraction likewise drops sharply from 0.9959 in the neighbor to 0.3186 in the query, a -0.6773 change that is clearly unfavorable for passive brain entry. QED drug-likeness is also lower in the query (0.7356 vs 0.8705; delta -0.1349), and the fraction of sp3 carbons rises slightly from 0.125 to 0.1667 (+0.0417), which in this neighbor comparison is not helping. Taken together, though, the query still looks better than this neighbor on the majority of the stated properties, so Neighbor 5 supplies more support for option (B) than for option (A).

Neighbor 6 follows the same pattern as Neighbor 5.
